mapper.select: select distinct sm.* from sys_admin_role sur LEFT JOIN sys_role sr on sur.role_id = sr.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu srm on sr.role_id = srm.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu sm on srm.menu_id = sm.menu_id where sur.admin_id = #{adminId} and sr.role_status = 0 and sm.menu_status = 0 and sm.perms is not null
